sections.text:
Ability Power 360. Damages all enemies with magic fire damage.
Ability Power boosted by 5 for each increase in Skill level.
-Curses all enemies for 60 seconds at success of 60 points.
-Casts resurrection on all allies.
-Applies 10% Life Drain on all allies for 40 seconds.
-Increases the Unison gauge gains of all allies by 5 every 10 seconds for 40 seconds.
-Recovers 30 Cost for your character.
